summary: Diagnose exact L4 Source evidence bundle binding failure in qualification run 37689932878 at commit 8764ad85 and correct controller-owned scheduled tenant resolution in pipeline producer binding without relaxing authority gates.

diagnosis.actual_gha_observation: In qualification run 37689932878 at commit 8764ad85, GHA report/logs captured: 'RuntimeError: Teaching evaluation job failed: evaluation_admission_rejected: source DatasetVersion authority rejected: exactly one source evidence bundle must bind the selected connector run'. Crucially, observed_count and matching_count were NOT present in the raw GHA log capture because _select_evidence_bundles at 8764ad85 emitted only the unadorned error string.
diagnosis.distinction_reproduction_vs_gha: The initial manifest attempt in commit c5cbdead conflated local reproduction with raw GHA logs. In actual GHA logs, only the unadorned admission error appeared. The exact observed cardinality (matching_count=0, observed_count=0 for tenant-dev) was identified via local reproduction under the deployment configuration hypothesis, where PANTHEON_TENANT_ID was unset in the source ingestion container environment while training-session queried with X-Tenant-Id: tenant-dev.
diagnosis.cache_fix_relationship: In qualification run 37689932878, the PostgreSQL cache fix (PR 6320/6322) did not resolve the L4 failure. A possible contributing defect is not excluded, and no claim is made that the cache fix caused or did not cause the failure; the empirical fact is that the failure persisted at 8764ad85 after the cache fix.
diagnosis.deployment_config_hypothesis_and_root_ca: On the producer side, source-ingest runs scheduled connector tw_official_pull without PANTHEON_TENANT_ID in the container environment, and connector.metadata had no explicit tenant_id. Consequently, pipeline.py resolved connector_tenant to None, omitting the tenant stamp on source records and resulting in evidence bundles stored in PostgreSQL with payload->'metadata'->>'tenant_id' as None (untenanted). When training-session queried GET /api/source-ingest/evidence/bundles with header X-Tenant-Id: tenant-dev, PostgreSQL filtered bundles by payload->'metadata'->>'tenant_id' = 'tenant-dev', resulting in zero matching bundles for tenant-dev and causing _select_evidence_bundles to fail closed.
diagnosis.causal_link: Producer pipeline did not resolve tenant from authoritative persisted controller state when container environment variable PANTHEON_TENANT_ID was unset, creating an untenanted bundle invisible to tenant-scoped consumer queries.
diagnosis.previous_attempt_record: Failed attempt preserved: Commit c5cbdead initially claimed GHA logs reported observed matching_count=0/observed_count=0. Corrected: GHA logs captured only the unadorned admission rejection error; the counts and untenanted bundle mechanism are reproduced locally under the deployment configuration hypothesis. No forged evidence.

fix.producer: In services/source_ingestion/pipeline.py, introduce _resolve_connector_tenant(connector, runtime) helper. When connector is controller-owned (reconciliation managed by persona_source_provisioning_reconciler) and env vars are unset, fall back to reading tenant_id from runtime.CONTROLLER_STATE_PATH. Apply consistently in both run_job and persist_source_evidence_refs.
fix.consumer_diagnostics: In services/training-session/source_dataset_authority.py, enhance _select_evidence_bundles failure message when matching_count != 1 with bounded, redacted diagnostics (matching_count, selected connector, run_id, observed_count, and sample bundle metadata [id, connector, run, tenant]) without exposing tokens, auth headers, or raw payload content.
fix.fail_closed_invariants: Strict single bundle requirement, exact connector/run match, tenant isolation, future timestamp rejection, and SHA-256 integrity remain strictly enforced without any test or assertion relaxations.
